name: LLM-Telecom evaluation benchmarks
description: A suite of three novel benchmarks designed to evaluate telecom-specific large language models on math modeling, open-ended question answering, and code-related tasks including generation, infilling, summarization, and analysis.
reputation: A niche, domain-specific benchmark that has seen limited but growing use in telecom LLM evaluation papers, rather than broad community adoption.
notes: Benchmarks address the lack of telecom-specific evaluation datasets and cover a holistic range of telecom LLM capabilities.
